pages.title: What Raises It
pages.text: Instability is a numeric score born of silence, contradiction, and greed. Sparse books, random vows, clashing commands, costly terrain, cruel weather, crowded biomes, and powerful laws all change it. Losing the last tracked copy of a linked descriptive-book lineage adds a savage $(thing)200 instability$().

pages.title: What Lowers It
pages.text: A named thing is calmer than an unnamed one. Define terrain, biomes, time, sun, moon, stars, and weather. A single biome, Vanilla Distribution, Standard terrain, normal weather, authored landmarks, and explicit sky details all grant relief. See $(l:mystcraft-reforged:instability/stability_scoring)How Stability Is Scored$() for the exact values.

pages.title: Effects
pages.text: By default, symptoms begin at score 45 and accumulate at 65, 80, 100, and 115: slowness and fatigue; darkness and poison; lightning; black or white decay; then explosions. Low nonzero instability does not cause direct symptoms, so an Age need not reach zero to become livable. See $(l:mystcraft-reforged:instability/instability_levels)Instability Levels$() for rates and configuration.

pages.title: Curses
pages.text: Some wounds are not the fever itself, but one cruel phrase still caught in the script: endless storm, harmful enchantment, thin gravity, hostile surges, lifeless silence, locked time, or a starless sky. A linked descriptive book will name these on its survey once the Age is known.

pages.title: Cleansing
pages.text: Set the linked descriptive book in the $(thing)Editing Table$() with a $(item)Curse Cleansing$() page, one ink vial, four lapis, and an amethyst shard. The strongest curse is removed first. Relief is: harmful effect 24, storm 18, hostile surge 16, lifeless silence 14, time lock 12, low gravity 10, rain 8, starless sky 6.

pages.title: Control
pages.text: Those with steward's authority may speak $(thing)/mystcraft instability toggle$() while standing in an Age. This stills or wakes the symptoms for the whole family of that Age, lesser Nether and End included, but it does not lower the raw fever. The sickness remains beneath the skin.
